description.text: Featured advantages This major is a discipline set up by Chutian scholars, a first-class professional construction point in Hubei Province, and a member of the International Elite Business School Association. It has a provincial-level internship training base and virtual simulation laboratory in Hubei universities, and has established cooperative relations with more than 20 well-known domestic enterprises such as Vanke Group and China Business Parity. The teaching staff is strong, 90% of the teachers come from the industry, pay attention to project-based teaching, adopt the "business-learning integration" characteristic talent training model, and cultivate a group of private entrepreneurs such as Lu Weijian, general manager of Asia Minor, and the student employment rate reaches more than 95%.Cultivation goals This major cultivates to meet the needs of economic and social development, develop morally, intellectually, physically, aesthetically and laboriously, and systematically master the basic theories, basic knowledge and basic skills of business administration; Familiar with the characteristics of modern enterprise management; Have the ability to innovate and start-up, rational decision-making and scientific leadership; High-quality application-oriented professionals who can engage in strategic decision-making, operation management, corporate governance, project investment and financing in enterprises, institutions and administrative departments.Core courses Management, Strategic Management, Organizational Behavior, Entrepreneurial Management, Operations Management, Corporate Governance, Human Resource Management, Financial Management, MIS, Marketing, Business Model Design, Market Research and Forecasting, Brand Building and Management, Entrepreneurial Theory and Practice.

duration.text: The Business Administration at Wuchang University of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1666 USD/per year ￥ 12000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Colored scanned copy of passport which is valid for at least one year2. White background colored bareheaded digital photo in Passport size(The head takes up 2/3 of the size of the photo; the photo pixel is no less than 320*240, the aspect ratio is 4:3, the size is 100-500kb, JPG format)3. The colored scanned copy of the original diploma of secondary high school and above (If it is not in English, an English or Chinese translation shall be provided.)4. The colored scanned copy of the original transcript of secondary high school and above (If it is not in English, an English or Chinese translation shall be provided.)5. Educational background and working experience detailed from primary school to the date of application6. Transfer letter with attendance record for applicants with studying experience in China7. Fixed deposit certificate with minimum US $30008. Medical report9. None criminal record

requirements.text: Non-Chinese citizens, physically and mentally healthy.Non-Chinese citizens of secondary high school graduates, holding valid foreign passports in good health and with good character.
